question: Does removing the non-generalizing single-sibling subtraction let unchanged target-memory FFA select an IoU-at-least-0.5 native SAM2 mask in all three D13 frames?

predecessor.observed_failure: FFA improved the fixed D13 panel from 1/3 to 2/3. In D13M3 the qualifying target had target-memory cosine 0.68 versus 0.61 for the selected partial proposal, but sibling subtraction reversed their contrastive order to 0.05 versus 0.06.
predecessor.single_change: Rank the exact frozen candidates by maximum target-memory FFA cosine only; remove sibling subtraction while preserving proposal, FFA, target memory, SAM and IoU contracts.

masker.contract: Apply the unchanged native SAM2 settings to the new target-only top-one boxes solely to reproduce their tight-mask-bbox evaluation.

evaluation.candidate_authority: Reuse exact proposal boxes, objectness and already computed FFA target-memory scores from the predecessor; no GroundingDINO or DINOv2 rerun.
evaluation.truth_role: Provider target boxes enter only after target-only ranking to evaluate selected-mask tight-bbox IoU.

decision_gate.interpretation: Every target-only FFA top-one native mask must have tight-bbox IoU at least 0.5.

literature_motivation.use: Use direct instance-template FFA matching; do not impose a single scene-specific negative exemplar that can suppress the target under viewpoint change.

forbidden_after_freeze: change candidates, target-memory scores, target aggregation, tie-break, SAM settings or IoU gate
blend objectness, sibling score, box geometry or query truth into the rank
fit a threshold or adapter, replace a frame or add post-outcome rescue
claim_boundary: This consumed D13 Development ablation can establish only whether direct target-template FFA ranking repairs the observed negative-memory reversal. It cannot establish fresh-family confirmation, open-set rejection, raw-phone or provider-independent generalization, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
